text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I am Eishin Flash.
It is a pleasure to make your acquaintance.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
To ensure these three years are spent without a single wasted moment,
let us first construct a meticulous schedule together.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In order to execute this perfect schedule flawlessly, I intend to pour all my energy into the races. Please, lend me your support.

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
